aiOverview.content: Yes, Coco Gauff and Alycia Parks are childhood friends who have known each other for over a decade, having grown up in the same South Florida tennis circles. They frequently practiced together when they were younger and maintain a close, supportive relationship off the court, often sharing warm, friendly moments after competing against each other. Key Details About Their Relationship: Long-term Connection: They met when Gauff was around 7 or 8 years old, with Parks (who is three years older) inviting her to train in the Delray Beach/Treasure Coast area. Competitive Respect: While they are friends, they have competed on professional stages, including the 2024 Australian Open and the 2026 Miami Open. On-Court Dynamic: Gauff noted in of the Tennis.com article that they are friends who root for each other, but they maintain a competitive mindset during matches. Tennis.com Net Moments: They have shared friendly hugs at the net following their matches. They are part of a close-knit group of Black tennis players in South Florida.
